C0260.title: Sichuan Liangshan Police Crack Down on Short-Video-Driven Counterfeit Local Specialty Scam
C0260.summary: Police in Liangshan, Sichuan, dismantled an online fraud ring that staged poverty-themed short videos to fabricate tragic stories about the region, attracting traffic for live-stream sales of counterfeit local specialties. The group hired online water armies to inflate engagement, with the amount involved exceeding 20 million yuan, and over 50 suspects were taken into custody.
